biotools.summary: COATi is a statistical, codon-aware pairwise aligner designed to improve sequence alignment accuracy by accounting for indels within codons, addressing limitations of traditional aligners. It is designed to reduce discarded data and provides enhanced sequence alignments for genomic data.
